years.description: Calendar years; values are for the end of each year
years.title: Years

tree_years.description: Tree year (0 = first) for each entry in 'years'
tree_years.title: Tree Years

annual.description: One value per year. crop: Crop code grown in the year; crop_yield_t_ha: Crop yield per cropped area at the end of the season (t/ha, at crop moisture); crop_byproduct_t_ha: Crop by-product, e.g. straw (t/ha of cropped area); trees_per_ha: Standing trees at year end; tree_height_m: Tree height at year end (m); tree_dbh_cm: Diameter at breast height at year end (cm); canopy_cover_pct: Canopy area (% of land, capped at 100); prune_height_m: Clear stem height (m); stand_volume_m3_ha: Standing timber volume at year end plus timber harvested in the year (m3/ha); harvest_volume_m3_ha: Timber removed by thinning or felling in the year (m3/ha); branch_volume_m3_ha: Branchwood volume at year end (m3/ha); harvest_branch_m3_ha: Branchwood removed in the year (m3/ha); fruit_t_ha: Tree fruit harvested in the year (t/ha); tree_carbon_t_ha: Carbon in trees including roots at year end (t C/ha); tree_co2_t_ha: The same as CO2 (t CO2/ha, x3.67); rain_mm: Precipitation (mm/yr); irrigation_mm: Irrigation (mm/yr); drainage_mm: Flow to groundwater (mm/yr); tree_water_mm: Tree water uptake (mm/yr); crop_water_mm: Crop water uptake (mm/yr); evaporation_mm: Soil evaporation (mm/yr); days: Simulated days in the year
annual.title: Annual

daily.description: Only when daily_variables is set; dates follow weather.start
daily.title: Daily

reference_workbook_sha256.description: The Excel workbook the port is tested against
reference_workbook_sha256.title: Reference Workbook Sha256

mean_crop_yield_t_ha.description: Mean of crop_yield_t_ha over years with a crop, as the workbook's summary (cropped area)
mean_crop_yield_t_ha.title: Mean Crop Yield T Ha

max_stand_volume_m3_ha.description: Largest standing + cumulative harvested timber volume (workbook 'final tree vol')
max_stand_volume_m3_ha.title: Max Stand Volume M3 Ha

max_stand_biomass_odt_ha.description: The same as oven-dry tonnes (x wood density)
max_stand_biomass_odt_ha.title: Max Stand Biomass Odt Ha
